name: Daretti
description: Daretti is a goblin of uncommon intellect, talent and ambition, a planeswalker and engineer who built mechanical devices and later led the Rocketeers goblin team.

description_citations.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Daretti is a goblin of uncommon intellect, talent and ambition, a planeswalker and engineer who built mechanical devices and later led the Rocketeers goblin team.

citations.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Rumors held that Muzzio had killed Daretti.

citations.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

bio.text: A former Academy supplicant in a mechanical chair, Daretti joined Grenzo's goblins in looting Zadrous Fimarell's villa, where he found blueprints for one of the first cogwork sentries bearing the Academy seal.

citations.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.
"Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

bio.text: He accused Fimarell of stealing his manuscript and career, then threw him from the window to the street, and named Alendis as his next target.

citations.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.
"Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

bio.text: His profile says he returned to Fiora to reshape Paliano's power structures, that his schemings caused the Academy to be disbanded, and that he helped instigate the goblin riots.

citations.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: In the Aetherdrift race he led the Rocketeers goblins, was abandoned by Redshift and the goblins when they were trapped, and was caged by raiders with Loot, with whom he shared chocolate.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

bio.text: Pia freed him and Loot, and after the Omenpath dropped their car into an Amonkhet oasis, he helped Pia and Chandra build a new engine from palm fibers, hippo bones and scrap.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

bio.text: Over Ghirapur he sent drones to scout.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story, Daretti is alive and in Ghirapur with the racers, sending drones to scout.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Tulando and Grinaldi discuss rumors that Muzzio serves the Black Rose, sponsors Sydri and killed Daretti.
timeline.quote: He most certainly killed Daretti.

citation.text: "Like Cogwork" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 May 2014.

timeline.summary: A mob of goblins pelts the sentry with vegetables and a firebomb to draw him from his post.
timeline.quote: Weapon raised, he raced for them.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo smashes in the villa door with his staff, grumbling that Marchesa locked him out of his dungeons.
timeline.quote: One sharp thump from his staff and the villa door crashed to the ground.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo's goblins flood into the villa's foyer and start looting.
timeline.quote: The crowd of goblins flooded into the foyer

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo smashes Fimarell's desk and says the papers of praise are fuel.
timeline.quote: This is fuel.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti finds blueprints for one of the first cogwork sentries bearing the Academy seal.
timeline.quote: It's the blueprints for a cogwork sentry.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo tells Daretti the Academy is dead, Muzzio exiled and cogwork outlawed, and urges him to act like a hyena.
timeline.quote: Well, the academy is dead and Muzzio is exiled.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti, stirred, tells Grenzo to burn everything.
timeline.quote: Burn it. Burn it all. Burn the ashes.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti finds yellowed parchment among the papers that tells him it is time for fresher prey.
timeline.quote: He withdrew some yellowed parchment.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: At the top of the stairs Daretti forgets his speech and Grenzo prompts him through it.
timeline.quote: I've forgotten it.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Fimarell spots the goblins in the hallway, yells thieves and slams his bedroom door.
timeline.quote: "Thieves!" Fimarell yelled and slammed the door.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti delivers his speech accusing Fimarell of falsehood and deception.
timeline.quote: And it is the burden of the honest to bring lies to bear and carry the falsifier to justice.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti's chair extends mechanical legs and raises him like a spider over Fimarell.
timeline.quote: Daretti's chair extended its mechanical legs

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti reveals that Fimarell criticized his words and then took them as his own.
timeline.quote: You built your career on the back of my words.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti gags Fimarell with a page of the stolen manuscript.
timeline.quote: He balled up the top page of the manuscript and shoved it into Fimarell's mouth.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti heaves Fimarell through the window; he falls two stories to the street.
timeline.quote: Daretti reached under Fimarell's legs and heaved him up and through the window.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo burns the manuscript in a pot and drops burning refuse onto the street.
timeline.quote: Grenzo dropped the torch after them.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo and Daretti bicker over who is whose protege while the fire takes hold of the villa.
timeline.quote: The flames caught quickly and the fire crackled, crawling up the walls.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti names Alendis, who apparently joined the Custodi, as his next target; Grenzo adds anyone in league with Marchesa.
timeline.quote: Sounds like the oily bastard joined the Custodi.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo muses that Marchesa once ran in shadows but now locks every door, and proposes crashing all their parties.
timeline.quote: Now she's got her comfy chair and locks every door at night.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Rocketeers struggle in the Amonkhet sand as Daretti's goblins are slammed.
timeline.quote: Daretti's guys are getting absolutely slammed out there.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Endriders attack the goblins with flaming chainsaws.
timeline.quote: Worst of all, a flick of a switch on each of the roaring weapons sets them ablaze.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The Speed Demons emerge from the sands in a glitching burst of demonic energy.
timeline.quote: the glowing, ghoulish explosion of demonic energy that can only be the Speed Demons

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti's goblins charge the beast but run into a snare net and raiders capture them.
timeline.quote: He can see it now: the net holding them aloft and the glowing, reptilian eyes of their captors.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Redshift and the goblins bail out of the trapped vehicle, abandoning Daretti.
timeline.quote: Bye, Boss! Real nice working with you!

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti is caged with Loot and introduces himself.
timeline.quote: The name's Daretti.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti shares Fioran chocolate with Loot as they expect to be sacrificed.
timeline.quote: If we're going to be sacrificed the way they say, at least we'll go out like gentlemen

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia picks the cage lock and frees Loot and Daretti.
timeline.quote: And, sure enough, Chandra's mom has the lock figured out all before Daretti has even realized there's anything going on behind him.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra sets off a fireball that blows up half the raiders' camp as they escape.
timeline.quote: As half of the camp explodes, she hops into the ride with the others.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Following Loot's cue, Chandra steers left into a tree whose bark falls away to reveal an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Beneath it, the spiraling light of an Omenpath.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: They crash across the border into a different world.
timeline.quote: A second later, they crash over the border into a different world.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The rocket car spirals out of the Omenpath above an oasis on Amonkhet instead of reaching Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the rocket car spirals into the air above an oasis on Amonkhet

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The car crashes into the oasis.
timeline.quote: An instant later, the ship hits the earth.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra wakes first, concussed, and checks on the others.
timeline.quote: Chandra's the first one to wake beneath the warm sun of Amonkhet.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti offers medicine for the concussions and hands Chandra a cup.
timeline.quote: If you need medicine, I've plenty.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti concludes the engine is blown and they must improvise from scrap.
timeline.quote: I regret to inform you we've blown the engine.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti, Pia and Chandra build an all-new engine from palm fibers, hippo bones and scrap.
timeline.quote: I believe we're developing an all-new type of engine here, purely out of desperation.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti takes over the night work on the engine.
timeline.quote: I think that's most of the welding work done for the evening.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia hot-wires the cobbled-together car.
timeline.quote: Pia's rubbing two wires together beneath the steering wheel.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Falling toward Ghirapur, Chandra sees the crowd panicking instead of celebrating.
timeline.quote: But as she realizes that the masses below are not celebrating but panicking, a different feeling takes hold.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra scorches a roof to slow the falling car, then jumps clear.
timeline.quote: She aims for a sturdy-looking roof instead, then scorches the side of the same building all the way down to try and slow them down.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti sends drones to scout and Loot wakes from Jace's control.
timeline.quote: Even Loot's woken up

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: After some time away, Daretti returns to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano.
timeline.quote: After some time away, Daretti returned to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano that denied him his aspirations.

citation.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Daretti's schemings cause the disbanding of the Academy.
timeline.quote: His schemings were responsible for the disbanding of the Academy

citation.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Daretti helps instigate the goblin riots to overturn Paliano's leadership and root out former Academy members.
timeline.quote: were instrumental in instigating the goblin riots

citation.text: "Daretti". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: Well, at least I'll have good company.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

relations.quote: I promise I'll be a better boss than you ever were!

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: A goblin Rocketeers team boss who builds their crackling transmitters and drives an all-terrain tank in the race.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: A goblin Rocketeers boss captured by raiders and caged with Loot.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: A goblin engineer who tends to the concussed crew and builds a new engine from palm fibers and hippo bones.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.
